name: Mouz the Unclean

abilities.name: Kick
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Talon
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that deals moderate physical damage.

abilities.name: Bolt
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that deals moderate shock damage.

abilities.name: Lightning Gale
abilities.description: Mouz the Unclean conjures a shocking storm around itself then sends it forward at its target, dealing moderate shock damage. This doesn't have any red area indicators. This can be interrupted to set Mouz the Unclean off-balance.

abilities.name: Fling Feathers
abilities.description: Mouz the Unclean deals moderate oblivion damage, knocks down and stuns targets hit in a cone in front of it. Then "Aftershock" is always cast.

abilities.name: Aftershock
abilities.description: Three areas dealing minor oblivion damage are sent from it in three directions.

abilities.name: Call Flock
abilities.description: Mouz the Unclean peridically summons three harpies to fight for it.

summary: Mouz the Unclean is a harpy boss found in the Spire of the Crimson Coin public dungeon. It is accompanied by five harpies at the start of the combat.
